ordering: Historical package evaluation completed before assurance source edits. An export-preparation failure was retained and repaired by restoring exact export-ignored blobs; no original SDK/harness change was needed.
reuse: core.canonical, digest, record, validate and Rejected
review manifest/context/dispatch/lane-output validation and original source-attributed findings
Existing continuation envelope, experience records and previewed storage coordinator
Existing agent types; no permanent profiles or second memory store
selected_slice: Separate bounded inert assurance plan/history/recommendation envelope and SDK. External result ingestion only; no imported commands executed. Parent serializes shared contracts; implementation lane owns assurance module/tests/docs.

role_separation.coordinator: Implementation, evidence integration and explicit local persistence
role_separation.package_lane: Technical wheel execution; same-platform, not independent assurance
role_separation.implementation_lane: Source implementation and self-testing, not independent verifier

dissent: Cross-cutting, not a ninth compass coordinate. Center reasoning integrity is not another independent reviewer.

rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.proposal: Add knowledge-lifecycle, decision and dissent schemas for the slice.
rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.reason: User distinguishes evidence status from institutional knowledge lifecycle and forbids standalone decision/dissent contracts merely for checklist coverage. Use one scoped assurance envelope and existing findings/experience.

rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.proposal: Eight independence coordinates represent the eight canonical bearings.
rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.reason: Retained design names Policy/Security/Architecture/Adversarial/Verification/Operations/Portability/History; actor/model/prompt/evidence/environment/procedure/organization/custody are different independence dimensions.

rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.proposal: Add INCONCLUSIVE to continuation task-gate enum and treat absent evidence status as implicitly ACTIVE.
rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.reason: Task gates and assurance outcomes are explicitly distinct. The existing trust-evidence schema's missing status does not establish active eligibility; the new assurance path must represent eligibility explicitly.

rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.proposal: Continuation next_action is text only and requires redefining.
rejected_proposals_and_counterevidence.reason: Existing contracts.json codex.continuation-state.v1 already uses an object; core.candidate constructs action/preconditions/acceptance_test/idempotency. Reuse rather than break compatibility.
Preserve the user's exact six evidence statuses instead. Applicability/binding/critical unknowns remain separate fail-closed fields.

retained_challenges: A technical PASS cannot establish independent reproduction, authenticated identity or approval.
Sibling success or numeric aggregation cannot erase disputed evidence or source dissent.
Bind assurance evidence/results to original finding requirements, exact plan and procedure/version.
Revalidate downstream results after prerequisite replacement or evidence invalidation.
Require structural non-authority fields rather than prose-only disclaimers.
Imported procedures remain inert data; no shell or arbitrary runner.
formula_design_policy: Keep existing 58 source/normalized references, 27 design contracts and seven text alternatives unchanged. Add bounded executable mapping receipts; do not rewrite the registry or claim numeric calibration.
selected_deployment: Installed offline SDK with explicitly supplied inputs and separately previewed coordinator persistence. Hosted profiles, MCP filters and renderer-specific readiness remain unverified.
institutional_effectiveness: Descriptive component reuse, observed defects and reproducible results only; no causal effectiveness score or agent creation/retirement.
